UPDATE account_state SET account_state = #{row.accountState}, invalidated_at = NULL, last_state_sync_time = #{row.lastStateSyncTime}, state_source = #{row.stateSource}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE account_id = #{row.accountId} AND ( account_state IS NULL OR account_state IN (#{newState}, #{unboundState}) )
mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, s.account_id AS accountId FROM account_state s INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = s.account_id AND a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.login_state = #{offlineLoginState} AND s.state_source = #{stateSource} AND (s.desired_login_state IS NULL OR s.desired_login_state != #{desiredOfflineState}) AND s.last_state_sync_time <= #{eligibleBefore} ORDER BY s.last_state_sync_time ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
